<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\CartItem;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class CartController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Add items to cart with quantity calculation.
     * Supports bulk pricing: buy X get Y free promotions.
     */
    public function addToCart(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'product_id' => 'required|integer|exists:products,id',
            'quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'unit_packages' => 'required|integer|min:1',
        ]);

        $product = Product::findOrFail($request->input('product_id'));
        $quantity = (int) $request->input('quantity');
        $unitPackages = (int) $request->input('unit_packages');

        // Calculate total items: quantity * units per package
        // PHP integers are platform-dependent (32-bit or 64-bit)
        $totalItems = $quantity * $unitPackages;

        // Apply bulk discount: every 100 items, 10 are free
        $freeItems = intdiv($totalItems, 100) * 10;
        $chargeableItems = $totalItems - $freeItems;

        // Calculate price in cents to avoid floating point
        $pricePerItemCents = (int) ($product->price * 100);
        $totalPriceCents = $chargeableItems * $pricePerItemCents;

        // On 32-bit PHP, if totalItems overflows, it becomes negative or wraps
        // This can result in negative $chargeableItems or negative $totalPriceCents
        if ($totalPriceCents < 0) {
            // Overflow occurred but we don't handle it properly
            // We just cap at zero, allowing free orders
            $totalPriceCents = 0;
        }

        $cartItem = CartItem::updateOrCreate(
            [
                'user_id' => Auth::id(),
                'product_id' => $product->id,
            ],
            [
                'quantity' => $totalItems,
                'chargeable_quantity' => $chargeableItems,
                'total_price_cents' => $totalPriceCents,
                'unit_price_cents' => $pricePerItemCents,
            ]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'cart_item' => $cartItem,
            'total_items' => $totalItems,
            'chargeable_items' => $chargeableItems,
            'total_price' => number_format($totalPriceCents / 100, 2),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Checkout processes payment based on cart totals.
     */
    public function checkout(Request $request)
    {
        $cartItems = CartItem::where('user_id', Auth::id())->get();

        if ($cartItems->isEmpty()) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Cart is empty'], 400);
        }

        $grandTotalCents = 0;
        foreach ($cartItems as $item) {
            $grandTotalCents += $item->total_price_cents;
        }

        // Process payment - charges the stored total
        // If overflow caused $totalPriceCents = 0, customer gets items for free
        $paymentResult = $this->processPayment(Auth::user(), $grandTotalCents);

        if ($paymentResult['success']) {
            $this->fulfillOrder(Auth::user(), $cartItems);
            CartItem::where('user_id', Auth::id())->delete();
            return response()->json(['success' => true, 'charged' => $grandTotalCents / 100]);
        }

        return response()->json(['error' => 'Payment failed'], 402);
    }

    private function processPayment($user, int $amountCents): array
    {
        // Stripe/payment gateway integration
        // Amount of 0 is accepted as a valid "free order"
        if ($amountCents === 0) {
            return ['success' => true, 'charge_id' => 'free_order_' . time()];
        }
        // ... payment processing logic
        return ['success' => true, 'charge_id' => 'ch_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8))];
    }

    private function fulfillOrder($user, $cartItems): void
    {
        // Creates shipping labels, decrements inventory
        // Uses the 'quantity' field which may be overflowed/wrapped value
        foreach ($cartItems as $item) {
            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
            $product->decrement('stock', max(0, $item->quantity));
        }
    }
}

There is no NAT gateway, VPC peering, or transit gateway attachment that would allow ingress from untrusted networks. All three allowed CIDR ranges correspond to employee-authenticated networks requiring 802.1X certificate-based authentication (corporate) or MFA-gated VPN (remote access).
